sentences.en: I say that the city now has too much extravagance.
sentences.zh: 我说这座城市现在奢侈得过了头。

sentences.en: His extravagance is out of proportion to his wage.
sentences.zh: 他的挥霍超出了他工资的比例。

sentences.en: The bow tie gives him an air of extravagance.
sentences.zh: 领结让他看起来更加放肆不羁。

senses.zh: 奢侈，挥霍,奢侈品,过分（的事情）,放纵的言行
